name: One Night in Kawami
source:
A friendly and mysterious stranger guides you on a night out in Kawami. It's your first time in the big city. Make it count. 

[From [url=https://okjigu.itch.io/onenightinkawami]Itch.io[/url]]

One Night in Kawami is an updated remake of [url=/p14716]Brand New Whatever[/url]'s [url=https://twinery.org/]Twine[/url] game "[url=https://okjigu.itch.io/oops]Out of Phase Synchronicity[/url]".
translation:
一位友好而神秘的陌生人将引导你在河见度过一个夜晚。这是你第一次来到大城市。让它算数。

[来自[url=https://okjigu.itch.io/onenightinkawami]Itch.io[/url]]

《河见之夜》是 [url=/p14716]Brand New Everything[/url] 的 [url=https://twinery.org/]Twine[/url] 游戏“[url=https://okjigu.itch.io/oops]异相同步[/url]”的更新版。
